scale_presets.label: Resolution scale presets
scale_presets.description: Automatically apply a scale after a resolution change. Use WIDTHxHEIGHT=SCALE for every display or PORT:WIDTHxHEIGHT=SCALE for one port. Examples: 3840x2160=1.5 · DP-3:1920x1080=1

refresh_interval.label: Fallback refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_interval.description: Recovery polling interval. Output changes normally refresh immediately through Noctalia's output hook, and focused-display changes are tracked reactively.

show_resolution.label: Show display details
show_resolution.description: Show the focused display's port and current resolution beside the bar icon. Disable for an icon-only widget.

panel.subtitle: Configure your display outputs in Niri
panel.temporary_note: Changes use Niri's temporary output IPC and are not written to your Niri config.

error.title: Couldn't read Niri displays
error.niri_missing: The niri executable was not found in PATH.
error.outputs: Could not query outputs from Niri.
error.parse_outputs: Niri returned output data that could not be parsed.
error.timeout: Niri did not respond in time.
error.mode_missing: No refresh rate is available for that resolution.
